changelog: Sales lead page (`/sales/leads/[id]`): two independent columns on wide screens — follow-up and recent interactions on the left, trial end, estimated value and the contact card stacked on the right (`SalesRecordPanels`). The contact card is compact: "Edit contact" sits on the heading line at the right, name/position/phone share two columns and the e-mail gets its own line The interactions card lists each entry in two lines with a hairline between entries — type, headline and a calendar-day distance (`relativeDay()`, `<RelativeTime granularity="day">`: today / yesterday / 3 days ago, the date on hover) on the first, the note clipped to one line and opened by a click on the second (#3803).

en: The lead page now has two columns: what to do next and what happened on the left, the trial, the estimated value and the contact on the right. The contact card is more compact, with "Edit contact" next to its heading.
Recent interactions are easier to scan: each one takes two lines, separated by a line, with "today", "yesterday" or "3 days ago" on the right. Click a note to read all of it.
tr: Lead sayfası artık iki sütunlu: solda sıradaki adım ve yapılan etkileşimler, sağda deneme süresi, tahmini değer ve iletişim. İletişim kartı daha derli toplu; "İletişimi düzenle" başlığın yanında.
Son etkileşimler daha kolay okunuyor: her biri ince bir çizgiyle ayrılmış iki satır, sağda "bugün", "dün" ya da "3 gün önce". Notun tamamını görmek için üstüne tıkla.
de: Die Lead-Seite hat jetzt zwei Spalten: links der nächste Schritt und die bisherigen Kontakte, rechts Testphase, geschätzter Wert und Kontakt. Die Kontaktkarte ist kompakter, „Kontakt bearbeiten“ steht neben der Überschrift.
Die letzten Kontakte sind übersichtlicher: jeder Eintrag zwei Zeilen, durch eine Linie getrennt, rechts „heute“, „gestern“ oder „vor 3 Tagen“. Ein Klick auf die Notiz zeigt sie vollständig.
